complaints.text: I waited 10 minutes for the login code but it never came. Then an error popped up saying 'OTP expired' even though I never got it. This keeps happening and I can't get into my account.
The OTP just won't send. I've tried 3 times, restarted my phone, checked signal. After waiting, it says 'Failed to send code'. I'm locked out and really frustrated.
I added everything to my cart, went to checkout, but there's no Pay button at all. Just a blank space where it should be. I can't complete my order no matter what I do.

After filling my cart, I tapped checkout and the screen just shows my items and a continue button that does nothing. No Pay option appears. I've tried closing and reopening the app but it's still missing.
I tapped Pay twice because nothing happened after the first tap, and now I see two charges on my card for the same order. I only wanted to pay once. Please refund the extra amount.
The payment button didn't respond so I tapped it again. Now I've been charged double for one purchase. I checked my bank and there are two identical transactions. This is not okay.
I applied my coupon and the cart showed 20% off, but when I went to pay, it charged me the full price. The discount disappeared at checkout. I feel tricked.
The app said my promo code was applied and showed the lower price in the cart, but the final charge was the original amount. I didn't get the discount I was promised.
I use the app in Spanish, but suddenly an error message popped up in English saying 'Network error'. It was jarring and confusing since everything else is in Spanish.
After an update, I started getting error messages in English even though my phone and app language are set to French. I don't understand what the errors mean now.
I use TalkBack and when I navigate to the cart, it only says '3' instead of 'Cart, 3 items'. I don't know what the number means without the label.
As a screen reader user, the cart button is announced as just a number, like '2', with no context. I can't tell it's the cart unless I memorize what the number means.
I opened the orders page and it's just been showing a spinning circle for over 5 minutes. Nothing loads, no matter how long I wait or how many times I refresh.
The orders tab is stuck on a loading spinner forever. I've tried restarting the app, clearing cache, even reinstalling. It never shows my orders, just keeps loading.
I need to change my delivery address for my next order but I can't find where to do it. I've looked in profile, settings, checkout - nowhere seems to let me edit it.
I want to update my address but the app doesn't make it obvious how. I tapped everywhere and still can't find the option to change it. It's frustratingly hidden.
Please add a dark mode. It's hard on my eyes to use the bright white interface at night. Many other apps have it, I'd love to see it here too.
I wish you offered cash on delivery as a payment option. I don't like using cards online and would shop more if I could pay when I get my order.
